name: Run Node.js commands on the Docker task runner
description: Runs Node.js command lines on the Docker task runner with environment variables, once without a connection and once with an HTTP Client connection whose parameters the commands read from a JSON file to call an echo API. The commands write their result to output.json.
shortDescription: Run Node.js command lines with environment variables and a connection.
keyFeatures: Node.js executed by the Docker task runner instead of the in-process GraalVM sandbox
Connection parameters handed to the code, with secrets masked in the captured output
Structured results returned through vars, next to stdout, stderr and the exit code
prerequisites: The Docker task runner enabled with bytechef.script.runners.docker.enabled=true
A Docker daemon the ByteChef server can reach, with internet access to pull images
HTTP Client connection to https://postman-echo.com with Bearer Token authentication
idealFor: Developers who need a real language runtime, its libraries or local tools in a workflow step, beyond what the sandboxed GraalVM runner allows.
steps: Without Connection runs the code with the task's input and returns a greeting and runtime details.
With Connection reads the echo connection's base URI and token and calls the echo API with them.
